adiposity.meaning: Illustrative size. Not a body-fat percentage.

selectionRecord: Evaluated NAVER Anny 0.6.2 (Apache-2.0 code, CC0 MakeHuman data). It is not bundled: the PyTorch runtime would block Home, LYB-321 forbids an Anny reconstruction provider or photo upload, and SMPL-X assets are non-commercial. This original torso keeps one topology and one rig so presentation and shape can interpolate. Sliders are illustrative, not body-fat or FFMI.
